integrity: Finite numerical consistency checks are supplementary to a complete analytical proof; no claim of external verification or independent historical certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact Gauss–Chebyshev nodes, equally weighted discrete cosine samples, loss of two nodes and of two highest polynomial degrees only. No result for other norms, nodes, higher losses or finite precision. The full text of Goren–Zamir (2021) was inaccessible; historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp two-erasure stability of near-Nyquist Chebyshev–Gauss cosine sampling
